name: Beyla Integration Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  integration-tests:
    name: Integration Tests
    runs-on: [ self-hosted, linux, x64, beyla ]
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - test: "beyla-integration"
            weights_file: "internal/test/integration/weights-beyla.yaml"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'

      - name: Generate integration test matrix
        env:
          WEIGHTS_FILE: ${{ matrix.weights_file }}
        run: |
          ./scripts/generate-integration-matrix.sh

      - name: Run integration tests
        run: |
          make integration-test

      - name: Publish test results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        if: always()
        with:
          files: "test-results.xml"

      - name: Notify Slack on failure
        uses: act10ns/slack@44541246747a30eb3102d87f7a4cc5471b0ffb7d
        if: failure()
        with:
          webhook-url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          status: failure
          message: "Beyla integration tests failed on ${{ github.ref }}"

      - name: Notify Slack on success
        uses: act10ns/slack@44541246747a30eb3102d87f7a4cc5471b0ffb7d
        if: success()
        with:
          webhook-url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          status: success
          message: "Beyla integration tests passed on ${{ github.ref }}"
